whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm package.json no longer carries a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index.
